stem: Which quotation could most likely be attributed to Sandra Day O’Connor?

options.label: F
options.text: “The power I exert on the Court depends on the power of my arguments, not on my gender.”

options.label: G
options.text: “Yes, I did feel a special responsibility to be the first American woman in space.”

options.label: H
options.text: “I came to Washington to work for God, FDR, and the millions of forgotten, plain common workingmen.”

options.label: J
options.text: “I only knew that, as I was being arrested, that it was the very last time I would ever ride in humiliation of this kind.”
